packages.title: A positive prime-sum criterion
packages.critical_hypotheses: Fixed finite positive character combination; bounds on arbitrarily large multiplicative intervals imply the zero exclusion.

packages.title: Auxiliary fields and primes
packages.critical_hypotheses: Use one common zero-free boundary below one for all Dirichlet characters; selection must hold simultaneously with the cohomological interval.

packages.title: A coarse cohomological bound
packages.critical_hypotheses: Totally imaginary field, mu_p contained, positive twist E; explicit classical K-theory, stability, Hurewicz and duality inputs. This still uses arithmetic homology in sections13–14.

packages.title: Character components and congruences
packages.critical_hypotheses: Coarse finiteness does not give the needed uniform complementary-parity sums; the automorphic and integral congruence interface remains open.

packages.title: One compatible system of maps
packages.critical_hypotheses: The arithmetic and analytic estimates must refer to the same Hermitian lattices and maps; all constants must remain valid on growing chains and intervals.

packages.title: Integral coefficient lattices and periods
packages.critical_hypotheses: Control the actual lattices, quotient metrics, denominators and all-vector local divisibility, not only determinants.

packages.title: Integral theta maps
packages.critical_hypotheses: Use compatible local normalizations and lattices. Seed nonvanishing and auxiliary-level-prime divisibility remain required for the actual maps.

packages.title: Orbital and global energy estimates
packages.critical_hypotheses: Uniform coordinate-size and weighted lattice-pair estimates must close the global Gram-energy bounds.

packages.title: Ambient dimensions and norms
packages.critical_hypotheses: The ambient dimension, Haar measures, character spaces and normalizations must agree with those in the actual maps and Gram matrices.

packages.title: Radial operators and residue pairing
packages.critical_hypotheses: A fixed-chain algebraic restriction formula does not alone give convergence, an integrated residue pairing or bounds uniform in growing chains.

reading_spine: Fix the positive prime-sum family and its interval criterion.
Use uniform QRH and the K-theory coarse bound to choose compatible primes, fields and rank intervals.
Prove the required refined cohomological and congruence bounds.
Construct one system of integral theta maps with its exact lattices and all-vector divisibility.
Bound the Gram matrices and norms of those same maps using orbital, dimension and radial-residue analysis.
Apply one slope comparison and the numerical balance uniformly on the required intervals.
not_a_proof_dag: Packages organize work. Documentary cross-references, forward pointers and summaries are not logical premise edges; the remaining compatible-map existence theorem is still open.
